revenue_scope: Product revenue, net: RELYVRIO in the U.S. plus ALBRIOZA in Canada combined
geography: United States and Canada (combined; no split printed)
moa: combination of sodium phenylbutyrate and taurursodiol (proposed endoplasmic reticulum stress and mitochondrial modulation)

approval_evidence.quote: RELYVRIO SODIUM PHENYLBUTYRATE; TAURURSODIOL ... 09/29/2022 ORIG-1 Approval Type 1 - New Molecular Entity

launch_evidence.quote: the Company launched RELYVRIO in the United States of America, or U.S., on October 24, 2022

series_start_reason: The 'Product revenue, net' line covers ALBRIOZA in Canada from July 29, 2022 and RELYVRIO in the U.S. from October 24, 2022 (Q3 2022 Form 10-Q). The 2022Q3 row (345 thousand) is attributable to ALBRIOZA in Canada only (Q3 2022 earnings release and Form 10-Q MD&A), so it is outside the U.S.+Canada scope and is dropped; the series starts at 2022Q4, the first quarter in which both territories contribute.
series_end_reason: Relyvrio was withdrawn in 2024 (stated in the 2024 Form 10-Q). The 2026 Form 10-Qs no longer print the product revenue line; the Q2 2026 10-Q states 'following its withdrawal, we will no longer generate revenues from this product'. Last printed quarter is 2025Q4 (derived nil).
notes: Scope is U.S. (RELYVRIO) plus Canada (ALBRIOZA) combined for every row: FY2022 Form 10-K note 3 says shipments began in Canada in July 2022 and the U.S. in October 2022, and the FY2023 and FY2024 Form 10-K MD&A attribute the line to units of RELYVRIO and ALBRIOZA sold in the U.S. and Canada respectively. No filing, earnings release or Bigdata.com result read prints a U.S./Canada split, so no U.S.-only series exists. The 2022Q3 line (345 thousand, Canada only) is excluded from the series. Amylyx has no other product revenue (total revenues equal this line in 2022-2025). 2024Q2 (-1,023) and 2024Q4 (-665) are negative as printed. 2025 quarters are printed nil and kept as printed zeros. The series is in thousands of USD, recorded in millions.
search_log: Listed Amylyx Pharmaceuticals (CIK 0001658551) 10-Q/10-K/8-K filings from data.sec.gov/submissions; read 'Product revenue, net' in each 10-Q (three-month and nine-month columns) and each 10-K.
2024Q2 derived from six-month 2024 (87,620) less Q1 2024 (88,643), because the Q2 2024 three-month figure is printed as a split parenthesised negative that the source-check cannot read as a negative.
FDA: Drugs@FDA NDA 216660 lists 09/29/2022 ORIG-1 Approval for RELYVRIO (approval_evidence); an earlier lookup under NDA 215887 / 216113 returned other products.
Launch and commercial start: first printed sales are the three-month figure ended September 30, 2022 (345 thousand).

Scope re-check: read the Q3 2022 earnings release (8-K 0000950170-22-024448: Q3 net product revenue 'attributable to sales of ALBRIOZA in Canada'), the Q1/Q2 2023 releases ('RELYVRIO in the U.S. and ALBRIOZA in Canada'), the Q3 2023 10-Q MD&A, the FY2022/FY2023/FY2024 10-K notes and MD&A, and the Q4 2022, Q4 2023-Q3 2024 and Q4 2024 releases (0000950170-23-007580, -24-018409, -24-056254, -24-093304, -24-122779, -25-031303), plus every 10-Q/10-K cited in the CSV, for a regex of dollar amounts or percentages next to 'Canad'. None prints a U.S./Canada revenue split or a geographic disaggregation.
